Guess the ontology-anchored data type of a column

guess_data_type.Rd

Reads up to n_sample unique values and returns two aligned views of the column's type. The LEGACY view scores the values against every registered detector and reports the best-matching type (when its pass rate clears threshold) with its flat-ontology coordinates. The route view runs the v6 two-stage flow: a signature-based ROUTER shortlists ontology candidates, then a deterministic VERIFIER (confirm = detect o transform) confirms a leaf or gracefully truncates to the depth the router agrees on.

Usage

guess_data_type(
  x,
  name = NULL,
  n_sample = 100,
  threshold = 0.8,
  floor = 0.5,
  detectors = data_type_detectors(),
  seed = NULL,
  route = TRUE,
  ontology = NULL,
  router_k = 8,
  confirm_thr = 0.8,
  sig_floor = 0.55,
  router = c("auto", "learned", "signature")
)

Arguments

x

A vector (coerced to character) of column values.

name

Optional variable name; used only to break ties (e.g. a column named fips favors a FIPS detector over a same-shape ZIP detector).

n_sample

Maximum number of unique non-missing values to test.

threshold

Minimum pass rate for the top type to be reported as the legacy guess; below it, guess is NA (unknown).

floor

Minimum pass rate for a type to appear in candidates.

detectors

A named list of detector functions; defaults to the registry.

seed

Optional integer seed for reproducible sampling.

route

If TRUE (default), also compute the v6 router->verifier route record. Set FALSE to skip it (pure legacy behavior).

ontology

The v6 ontology used by the router/verifier; defaults to fx_ontology().

router_k

Router shortlist size (candidates handed to the verifier).

confirm_thr

Minimum verifier confirm rate for a discriminating variant to resolve a full leaf (depth 4).

sig_floor

Minimum router similarity for any non-NA route guess (signature router only).

router

Which Stage-1 router to use: "auto" (default) prefers the learned xgboost model in inst/extdata/router_xgb.rds and falls back to the signature router when xgboost or the artifact is unavailable; "learned" forces the model (route is NA if unavailable); "signature" forces the model-free signature router. route$router_method reports which ran.

Value

A list with the legacy fields:

guess

Best-matching detector type name, or NA.

ontology

Named vector c(data_type, data_subtype, data_class, data_format) for the guess (all NA if none).

confidence

The guess's pass rate.

candidates

Ranked data frame of types clearing floor.

n

Number of unique values scored.

and, when route = TRUE, a route sub-list anchored to the v6 ontology: data_type, semantic_family, semantic_type, semantic_type_id, variant_id, format_label, match_kind, depth (0 = unknown, 1 = data_type, 2 = family, 3 = semantic_type, 4 = leaf/format), confidence, dd_unit, and candidates (the router shortlist + verified table).

See also

score_data_type(), fx_stabilize(), fx_ontology()

Examples

guess_data_type(c("USD", "EUR", "JPY", "GBP"))$ontology
#>     data_type  data_subtype    data_class   data_format 
#> "categorical"     "nominal"    "category"        "code" 
guess_data_type(c("06037", "36061"), name = "county_fips")$guess
#> Warning: NAs introduced by coercion to integer range
#> [1] "county_fips"
guess_data_type(c("03/15/2019", "12/31/2020"))$route$format_label  # calendar
#> Warning: NAs introduced by coercion to integer range
#> Warning: NAs introduced by coercion to integer range
#> [1] "calendar"
